title: 正文 第六章，又见小萝莉
content_zh:
气海中的朦胧身影散发无形光华，洗礼着幻天的肉身，血肉在不停的改善，越发接近完美。每一丝血肉中都闪耀着神性的光芒。

    “力轮力之极尽，终于达到这个境界了，但这还只是‘成圣封神’其中一个能力。”幻天自语。成圣封神玄妙无尽，幻天竭尽全力，也难窥万一。这一肉身秘藏将会陪他走到很远。

    刚刚悟得唯一真身秘藏，并不是很稳定，身在空中的幻天有些摇晃。晓是如此，如若被人看见也会引起一番波澜。在外界也就算了，要知道这里是遗落之地，是有着禁空之力的，虽然离禁空结界很远，但这种高度，也非常人所能及。

    幻天摇晃，终是不稳，落下了石峰。石峰高达数百米，数百米的高度，幻天垂直落下，如陨落的星辰般，轰然落地。顷刻间土石皆崩，地上被砸出一个方圆数米的大坑。片刻后幻天爬出土层，吐出一口血沫，喘着气说道：“虽然达到了力轮力之极尽，可肉身并没有得到淬炼，对于我所拥有的力量来说，肉身还太过淳弱。眼下当务之急，是要尽快提升自己的肉身强度。”

    略作休息，幻天离开了石峰区域。他还记得在天空中和翼龙雕搏斗之时，曾看见一处山清水秀之地。

    “在遗落之地出现这么一片生机盎然的森林，用脚趾头想一想都能猜出，如此特殊的地势定有大造化，我幻天岂能不去凑个热闹。”

    古道西风，枯藤老树。

    随着行走，周围的环境开始变化，时时可见一两棵枯萎的古木，并且还有一些人类活动的痕迹。幻天猜测，这有可能是外界试炼之人留下的。

    根据记忆中的路线行走，路途中幻天还遇到了两个人，是一对是师兄妹，年龄大他几岁，都是天剑宗之人。男的叫陆典，身形消瘦，还算有几分英气。女的叫王语兰，身穿鹅黄色衣裙，头戴蝴蝶步摇，很是温柔，大部分都躲在陆典背后，偶尔也会好奇的看着幻天的白色头发。

    和两人交谈，幻天了解到，他所要去的地方名为万物塔，那里是他们的集结地也是他们的造化地，每次遗落之地开启，万物塔都会泄露庞大的灵气，使它周围的植物得以复苏，那里是遗落之地唯一可以动用法的地方。

    时间一到，人类和各种凶禽猛兽都会被万物塔的灵力吸引。那里充满造化的同时，也遍布着杀机，这杀机无处不在，有可能是各种凶禽猛兽，也有可能是你旁边的朋友。在利益面前，没人可以相信。

    外界之人来到遗落之地，会被随机传送到不同的地方。在这里，他们做的第一件事就是快速寻找到自己宗门或是家族之人。这样，存活的率才会大一点。久而久之，万物塔就成了他们的第一站

    在和几人的交谈中，幻天一直感觉有东西跟着他。不管他速度是慢还是快，余光下总能看到一具青色倩影。幻天微微一笑，就当没看见，依旧我行我素。就这样，过去了大半日，背后的人似乎失去了耐性。生气的叫道：“白毛，本姑奶奶都做的那么明显了，你还装傻，真拿我当空气了。”

    “白毛。”听到来人这么叫，幻天皱起了眉头。

    “哥哥，人家都追你半天了，你也不理人见。”似是感觉到了幻天生气，来人话语突然变得委屈，婉转。好似她根本没错，错的是幻天。

    “打住，谁是你哥哥。”幻天无语，转身看着背后的小萝莉继续说道：“别跟我套近乎，石心月，你没事跟着我干嘛呢？”

    “哥哥，你好没良心，人家可是救过你。在说了，我都对你那样了，还叫人家名字，叫我月儿就好了。”

    “喂！你把话说清楚，当时我是晕过去了，如果我不醒来，指不定会发生什么呢？”幻天火大。

    “不就是喝了你一点东西嘛！那么小气。”石心月委屈，眼泪都快流出来了。

    “晕过去？”

    “喝东西？”

    “没良心？”

    旁边的陆典和王语兰异口同声的大喊。

    “对啊！”

    “对啊！”幻天和石心月同时回答。

    “这个……幻兄……没想到你艳福不浅啊！当真是羡煞旁人。既然人家小姑娘都这么主动了，你总不能把一个如此美貌的小姑娘扔在这种虎狼环视的地方。”陆典突然坏坏一笑，暗地里对幻天竖起了大拇指。

    “陆典兄，你理解错了吧！这都什么跟什么啊！”幻天纳闷。

    “人家小姑娘都喝了你的东西了，再说你们也都承认了。我陆典也不是什么迂腐的人，这有什么不好意思的。”

    “妹妹，快到姐姐这来。”温柔的王语兰将石心月喊了过来。

    “你还这么小，他怎么能……没想到他看起来风神俊秀，温润如玉，竟然是这种人。”温柔的王语兰突然生气，声音也提高了几度。

    “不对，我想你们误会了，她喝的是……”

    “哎！大家明白就好，不用说出来。”陆典打断了幻天的话语。将他拉到一边偷偷摸摸的说道：“幻兄，我虽然年龄比你大，但在这方面跟你比还是略有不如啊！能不能指点指点兄弟。我那师妹我都追了五年了，也就牵牵手，抱抱腰。如果你能帮兄弟拿下，兄弟绝亏待不了你。”

    听着陆典喋喋不休的话语，幻天懒得搭理他。扭头看了一眼石心月，只见她眼眸带泪，委屈的不行。似是发现了幻天在看她，石心月一回头，暗地里对着幻天微微一笑，做出一个胜利者的笑容。
content_en:
The hazy figure in the sea of ​​​​qi exudes invisible brilliance, baptizing Huantian's body. The flesh and blood are constantly improving, getting closer and closer to perfection.The light of divinity shines in every trace of flesh and blood.
"The force of the wheel has been exhausted, and I have finally reached this state, but this is only one of the abilities of 'becoming a saint and becoming a god'." Huantian said to himself.The mysteries of becoming a saint and becoming a god are endless, and even if Huantian tries his best, it is still difficult to see what is going on.This physical secret will accompany him far.
Having just realized that the only secret treasure of the true body is not very stable, Huantian is a little shaken in the air.Akatsuki is like this, and if someone sees her, it will cause some trouble.Forget it in the outside world, you must know that this is the Forsaken Land, and it has the power of forbidden air. Although it is far away from the forbidden air barrier, this height is beyond the reach of humans.
Huantian shook, finally became unstable, and fell onto the stone peak.The stone peak was hundreds of meters high, and Huantian fell vertically from a height of hundreds of meters, crashing to the ground like a falling star.In an instant, the earth and rocks collapsed, and a large crater with a radius of several meters was made on the ground.After a while, Huantian crawled out of the soil, spat out a mouthful of blood foam, and gasped: "Although I have reached the limit of my strength, my physical body has not been tempered. For the power I possess, my physical body is still too weak. The top priority now is to increase the strength of my physical body as soon as possible."
After taking a short rest, Huantian left the Shifeng area.He still remembered that when he was fighting with the pterosaur eagle in the sky, he saw a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters.
"There is such a vibrant forest in the Forgotten Land. You can guess it with your toes. Such a special terrain must be a great blessing. How can I, Huantian, not join in the fun?"
The ancient road is blown by the west wind, with dead vines and old trees.
As you walk, the surrounding environment begins to change. One or two withered ancient trees can be seen from time to time, and there are also some traces of human activities.Huantian guessed that this might have been left behind by people who were undergoing trials from outside.
Walking according to the route in his memory, Huantian also met two people on the way. They were a brother and sister, a few years older than him, and both were from the Tianjian Sect.The man's name is Lu Dian. He is thin and somewhat heroic.The woman's name is Wang Yulan. She is wearing a goose-yellow dress and a butterfly bow on her head. She is very gentle. She mostly hides behind Lu Dian, and occasionally looks at Huantian's white hair curiously.
After talking to the two, Huantian learned that the place he was going to was called the Tower of All Things, which was their gathering place and the place of their creation. Every time the Forgotten Land was opened, the Tower of All Things would leak out huge spiritual energy, reviving the plants around it. It was the only place in the Forgotten Land where magic could be used.
When the time comes, humans and all kinds of ferocious birds and beasts will be attracted by the spiritual power of the Tower of All Things.While it is full of good fortune, it is also full of murderous intent. This murderous intent is everywhere. It may be various ferocious birds and beasts, or it may be the friend next to you.In the face of interests, no one can be trusted.
When outsiders come to the Forsaken Land, they will be randomly teleported to different places.Here, the first thing they do is to quickly find someone from their sect or family.In this way, the survival rate will be greater.Over time, the Tower of All Things became their first stop.
During the conversation with several people, Huantian kept feeling that something was following him.No matter whether his speed is slow or fast, he can always see a beautiful green figure in his peripheral vision.Huantian smiled slightly, pretending not to notice, and still went his own way.In this way, most of the day passed, and the people behind it seemed to have lost their patience.He yelled angrily: "Baimao, my aunt has already made it so obvious, but you are still pretending to be stupid. You are really taking me for granted."
"Baimao." Huantian frowned when he heard the call from the visitor.
"Brother, people have been chasing you for a long time, and you don't care." As if he felt Huantian's anger, the man's words suddenly became aggrieved and tactful.It seemed that she was not wrong at all, and it was Huantian who was wrong.
"Stop, who is your brother?" Huantian was speechless, turned around and looked at the little Loli behind him and continued: "Don't get close to me, Shi Xinyue, why are you following me when you have nothing to do?"
"Brother, you are so heartless, but I saved you. Now that I have done that to you, you still call them names. Just call me Yue'er."
"Hey! Please tell me clearly. I fainted at that time. If I didn't wake up, what might have happened?" Huantian Huoda said.
"I just drank something from you! You are so stingy." Shi Xinyue felt aggrieved and almost burst into tears.
"Fainted?"
"Drink?"
"ungrateful?"
Lu Dian and Wang Yulan next to them shouted in unison.
"yes!"
"Yes!" Huantian and Shi Xinyue replied at the same time.
"Well... Brother Huan... I didn't expect you to be so beautiful! I really envy others. Since other girls have taken the initiative, you can't leave such a beautiful girl in such a place where tigers and wolves are looking at you." Lu Dian suddenly smiled evilly and gave Huantian a thumbs up secretly.
"Brother Lu Dian, you got it wrong! This is all nonsense!" Huantian wondered.
"This little girl has already drank your food, and you all admit it. I, Lu Dian, am not a pedantic person, so there is nothing to be embarrassed about."
"Sister, come here quickly." The gentle Wang Yulan called Shi Xinyue over.
"You are still so young, how could he... I didn't expect that he looks handsome and gentle like jade, but he is this kind of person." The gentle Wang Yulan suddenly became angry, and her voice rose a few degrees.
"No, I think you misunderstood. What she drank was..."
"Hey! As long as everyone understands, there is no need to say it out loud." Lu Dian interrupted Huantian's words.He pulled him aside and said secretly: "Brother Huan, although I am older than you, I am still a little inferior to you in this respect! Can you give me some pointers? I have been chasing my junior sister for five years, so I just hold hands and hug my waist. If you can help brother win, brother will never treat you badly."
Listening to Lu Dian's endless words, Huantian was too lazy to pay attention to him.Turning his head to look at Shi Xinyue, he saw that her eyes were filled with tears and she was extremely aggrieved.As if she noticed Huantian looking at her, Shi Xinyue turned around and smiled secretly at Huantian, making a victor's smile.
title_en: Text Chapter 6, meet the little Loli again
